title: Sync PlanGrounding.PLAN_INTENT_ACTS and contextual-actions.ts with registered ActionVerbs

sections.what: Align PlanGrounding.PLAN_INTENT_ACTS and contextual action prompt suggestions with the verbs already registered in engine/action_verbs.py.
sections.why: engine/action_verbs.py (lines 64-160) registers valid character verbs including flee, frisk, release, offer, wake, fix, whisper, shout, stop, sit, and lie. However static/js/agent/plan-grounding.ts (PLAN_INTENT_ACTS, lines 55-67) omits all of them (causing plan steps using those verbs to fail grounding), and static/js/agent/prompt-builder/contextual-actions.ts (lines 320-395) omits flee alongside combat/movement options.
sections.how: 1. Audit engine/action_verbs.py (lines 64-160) against static/js/agent/plan-grounding.ts (PLAN_INTENT_ACTS, lines 55-67) and add valid in-world character verbs ('flee', 'frisk', 'release', 'offer', 'wake', 'fix', 'whisper', 'shout', 'stop', 'sit', 'lie', plus internal/social 'recall'/'guess' where appropriate) while keeping meta plumbing excluded.\n2. Update buildAvailableActionsBlock in static/js/agent/prompt-builder/contextual-actions.ts (lines 320-395) to surface 'flee' during active danger/combat and 'wake' around sleeping/unconscious characters (honoring turn_slots).\n3. Add JS unit tests confirming parity between ActionVerbs, PlanGrounding.ACTS, and contextual-actions suggestions.
sections.verify: 1. Run npm run build:ts and node tools/unit/run.cjs verifying PlanGrounding accepts 'flee', 'frisk', 'release', 'offer', 'wake', 'fix', 'whisper', 'shout', 'stop', 'sit', and 'lie', and contextual-actions surfaces 'flee'.

acceptance.text: PlanGrounding.PLAN_INTENT_ACTS in static/js/agent/plan-grounding.ts includes valid character verbs already registered in engine/action_verbs.py (flee, frisk, release, offer, wake, fix, whisper, shout, stop, sit, lie) while still excluding system/meta plumbing verbs.

contextual-actions.ts suggests contextually relevant survival/social verbs (such as flee when danger is present or others are co-located, and wake when someone is asleep/unconscious) within turn-slot budgets.
Unit tests cover PlanGrounding acceptance of those verbs and contextual suggestion output.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Agent Turn Modal Available Actions block (`contextual-actions.ts`) and Plan Mode step validation (`plan-grounding.ts`).

Current availability: engine/action_verbs.py registers flee, frisk, release, offer, wake, fix, whisper, shout, stop, sit, and lie, but PlanGrounding.PLAN_INTENT_ACTS omits all 11 and contextual-actions.ts omits flee.

Manual verification steps:
1. Build a multi-step plan containing flee, wake, frisk, or whisper steps and inspect PlanGrounding output.
2. Inspect the Available Actions prompt section for a character in danger alongside sleeping or hostile actors.
   - expected: PlanGrounding accepts registered character verbs cleanly and contextual-actions surfaces flee (and wake when applicable).
